name: Hung Dang
headline: CEO & Founder @Y42 | Turnkey data orchestration platform that never lets bad data go live
summary:
After being in the data space for over a decade and founding two successful data analytics companies, one thing is clear to me: Working with data is my passion and purpose. 

I believe data fundamentally aligns people. It empowers us to expand our consciousness, from unraveling the universe's mysteries all the way to understanding our day-to-day lives. 

It’s exactly that, the power of data, what inspired me to build a product that enables everyone to achieve maximum efficiency through a deep analytical understanding of their business. 

The future of the data space is about to change and Y42 is here to lead the way. 

—
These are the areas I know a thing or two about: 
- Software & Data Engineering
- Product Building 
- Data Analytics & Statistics
- Company Building
